syllabus.title: Chapter 1: Matru Bhasha Parimalam
syllabus.description: Telugu classical prose, poetic verses, aesthetic values, and functional grammar.

syllabus.title: Chapter 1: Do Bailon Ki Katha
syllabus.description: Story of self-respect, animal bonding, and freedom struggle symbolism by Premchand.

syllabus.title: Chapter 2: Lhasa Ki Aur
syllabus.description: Travelogue detailing Rahul Sankrityayan journey to Tibet and cultural reflections.

syllabus.title: Chapter 3: Upbhoktavad Ki Sanskriti
syllabus.description: Critical essay on modern consumerism, brand obsession, and social hypocrisy.

syllabus.title: Chapter 1: A Letter to God
syllabus.description: Lencho profound faith in God, devastation of the cornfield, and postmaster empathy.

syllabus.title: Chapter 2: Nelson Mandela - Long Walk to Freedom
syllabus.description: Inauguration day reflection on apartheid, courage, and true definition of freedom.

syllabus.title: Chapter 3: Two Stories about Flying
syllabus.description: Young seagull overcoming fear to fly & the mysterious black aeroplane in the storm.

syllabus.title: Chapter 4: From the Diary of Anne Frank
syllabus.description: Insights into teenager mindset in hiding during Holocaust and relationship with teacher Mr. Keesing.

syllabus.title: Chapter 5: Glimpses of India
syllabus.description: Cultural panorama of Baker from Goa, Coorg coffee hills, and Tea from Assam.

syllabus.title: Chapter 1: Real Numbers & Polynomials
syllabus.description: Fundamental number systems, proof of irrationality, quadratic and cubic polynomials.
topics: Zeroes of a Polynomial & Geometric Meaning

syllabus.title: Chapter 2: Linear Equations in Two Variables
syllabus.description: Algebraic and geometric methods of solving linear simultaneous equations.
topics: Graphical Method of Solution & Consistency Conditions
Word Problems on Speed, Time & Fractions

syllabus.title: Chapter 3: Quadratic Equations
syllabus.description: Standard form, factorization, quadratic formula, and discriminant nature of roots.
topics: Nature of Roots via Discriminant D = b^2 - 4ac

syllabus.title: Chapter 4: Arithmetic Progressions
syllabus.description: General term, common difference, nth term formula, and sum of first n terms.
topics: Definition of AP and Common Difference d
nth Term of an AP Formula an = a + (n-1)d
Sum of First n Terms Formula Sn = n/2(2a + (n-1)d)

syllabus.title: Chapter 5: Coordinate Geometry
syllabus.description: Cartesian coordinate system, distance formula, section formula, and collinearity.

syllabus.title: Chapter 6: Triangles & Trigonometry
syllabus.description: Similarity of triangles, basic proportionality theorem, and trigonometric ratios.
topics: Criteria for Similarity of Triangles (AAA, SSS, SAS)
Trigonometric Ratios (sin, cos, tan, cosec, sec, cot)

syllabus.title: Chapter 1: Chemical Reactions & Equations
syllabus.description: Balancing chemical equations, combination, decomposition, displacement, and redox reactions.
topics: Types of Reactions: Combination, Decomposition, Displacement
Corrosion and Rancidity in Daily Life

syllabus.title: Chapter 2: Acids, Bases & Salts
syllabus.description: Chemical properties of acids and bases, pH scale, neutralization, and salts chemistry.
topics: Properties of Acids and Bases & Indicators
pH Scale & Importance in Everyday Life
Baking Soda, Bleaching Powder & Plaster of Paris

syllabus.title: Chapter 3: Metals and Non-Metals
syllabus.description: Physical and chemical properties, reactivity series, ionic compounds, and metallurgy.
topics: Physical & Chemical Properties of Metals & Non-metals
Formation and Properties of Ionic Compounds
Extraction of Metals and Prevention of Corrosion

syllabus.title: Chapter 4: Life Processes
syllabus.description: Autotrophic and heterotrophic nutrition, respiration in plants and animals, and transportation.
topics: Respiration: Aerobic vs Anaerobic, Human Respiratory System
Excretion: Human Nephron Function & Plant Excretion

syllabus.title: Chapter 5: Light - Reflection and Refraction
syllabus.description: Ray optics, image formation by mirrors and spherical lenses, mirror and lens formulas.
topics: Reflection by Spherical Mirrors & Ray Diagrams
Refraction through Glass Slab & Snell Law
Lens Formula & Power of a Lens (Dioptres)

syllabus.title: Chapter 1: The Rise of Nationalism in Europe
syllabus.description: French revolution ideals, romantic imagination, revolutions of 1848, and unifications of Italy and Germany.
topics: The French Revolution & the Idea of the Nation
The Making of Nationalism in Europe & Liberal Ideology

syllabus.title: Chapter 2: Nationalism in India
syllabus.description: First World War impact, Non-Cooperation Movement, Civil Disobedience Movement, and the sense of collective belonging.
topics: First World War, Khilafat & Non-Cooperation Movement
Differing Strands within the Movement (Towns, Countryside, Plantations)
Towards Civil Disobedience & Salt March (Dandi March)
The Sense of Collective Belonging & National Symbols

syllabus.title: Chapter 3: Resources and Development
syllabus.description: Types of resources, sustainable development, resource planning in India, and soil classification.
topics: Classification of Resources & Rio Earth Summit 1992
Resource Planning in India & Conservation Need
Soil Types in India: Alluvial, Black, Red, Laterite, Arid

syllabus.title: Chapter 4: Agriculture & Water Resources
syllabus.description: Cropping patterns, major crops, technological reforms in agriculture, and water management systems.
topics: Types of Farming: Primitive, Intensive & Commercial
Major Food Crops: Rice, Wheat, Millets, Pulses

syllabus.title: Chapter 5: Power Sharing & Federalism
syllabus.description: Case studies of Belgium and Sri Lanka, horizontal and vertical power sharing, and decentralization in India.
topics: Case Studies: Belgium Model vs Sri Lanka Majoritarianism
Why Power Sharing is Desirable (Prudential & Moral Reasons)
Key Features of Federalism & What Makes India a Federal Country
Decentralization in India & Panchayati Raj 1992 Amendment

syllabus.title: Chapter 6: Gender, Religion and Caste
syllabus.description: Feminist movements, political representation of women, communalism, and caste in politics.
topics: Gender and Politics: Public/Private Division & Women Representation
Religion, Communalism and Politics & Secular State Principles
Caste and Politics: Caste Inequalities & Caste in Politics

syllabus.title: Chapter 7: Development & Sectors of the Indian Economy
syllabus.description: Income and other goals, national development, primary/secondary/tertiary sectors, and employment generation.
topics: What Development Promises: Different People, Different Goals
Primary, Secondary, and Tertiary Sectors of the Economy
Rising Importance of Tertiary Sector & MGNREGA 2005
